question: 2016 年 12 月 31 日现金账户数是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fcb.SK_AccountID) AS cash_account_count FROM atlas.dwd.fact_cash_balances fcb JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON fcb.SK_DateID = dd.SK_DateID WHERE dd.DateValue = DATE '2016-12-31' LIMIT 100

fibo_concepts.note: 现金账户 = 快照日有现金余额记录的经纪账户
余额快照日(实测含数据)
